final: WITH c AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tr.tradekind), s AS (SELECT k, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS avgcnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avgcnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avgcnt
